title: 49GAION Operating Protocol - signature record
description: The record of one human signature for an action of a listed decision type (Protocol §4.10, item 9; Standard §4.4, items 6 and 8). It holds only the payload hash, Cell codes, times and the sign-in evidence; no person's identity and no reference to one (Standard §1.1, item 9; 49GAION/DR-0049). This schema proves shape only; behaviour (replay, revocation, expiry, wrong executor, altered payload, revoked credential, signer Cell retired or stopped) is tested in the tests of each [ORG]AION's gateway.

signature_id.description: The signature ID recorded in the unit register.

decision_type.description: A type ID of the signature list.

target_code.description: The code of the part the action is on.

payload_hash.description: Hash of the canonical action payload; the gateway runs the call only when its hash equals this.

signer_cell.description: The code of the human Cell the signature is given for.

signer_seat_kind.description: The signer's Cell is a human seat. A signature by an AI Cell, including an attached assistant, is never valid (Protocol §4.10, items 6 and 7).

signer_role.$comment: RULE-NO-ACTING-OR-DEPUTY: acting fillers and deputies are the organisation's own mechanism (49GAION/DR-0049)
signer_role.description: Withdrawn by 49GAION/DR-0049. The signer is the position, under its own Cell code; whether a position has an acting holder or a deputy is the organisation's own mechanism, outside the system. A record that carries this field is refused.

delegation_ref.$comment: RULE-NO-ACTING-OR-DEPUTY: acting fillers and deputies are the organisation's own mechanism (49GAION/DR-0049)
delegation_ref.description: Withdrawn by 49GAION/DR-0049, with signer_role. Delegation between positions is read from the signing Cell's authority_scope (Standard §4.4, item 8). A record that carries this field is refused.

signer_identity_ref.$comment: RULE-NO-PERSON-REFERENCE: no person's identity, and no reference to one, in the system (49GAION/DR-0049)
signer_identity_ref.description: Withdrawn by 49GAION/DR-0049. The system records no person's identity and no reference to one; any record of who stood behind a signature is the organisation's own, outside the system (Standard §1.1, item 9). A record that carries this field is refused.

signer_credential.description: The credential the organisation's mechanism issued for the signing position, used with a fresh live sign-in (Standard §1.1, item 9; HF-10). Never an AI credential or a technical key.

kind.description: Never an AI credential or a technical key.

bound_to_one_person.$comment: RULE-NO-PERSON-REFERENCE: the gateway verifies the credential for the position, never the person (49GAION/DR-0049)
bound_to_one_person.description: Withdrawn by 49GAION/DR-0049: how the organisation issues its credentials is its own mechanism, outside the system. A record that carries this field is refused.

executor_cell.description: The Cell that may run the signed action; the gateway checks the caller is this Cell.

nonce.description: Single-use; the gateway refuses a nonce already used.

session_ref.description: The reference of the sign-in event at the organisation's mechanism, as evidence of the fresh live sign-in; it carries no person's identity.

sign_in_evidence.description: Evidence of the fresh live sign-in made at signing (HF-10).
